use  black and white colors only
Visual Style: 
   - Theme: Dark
   - Primary color: Black (#000000), serving as the background color for heightened contrast
   - Accent colors: White (#FFFFFF) and Silver Metallic (#C0C0C0), used for text, borders, and highlights, contributing to a modern and premium feel 
   - Spacing: Uniform 30px spacing between all elements for an uncluttered layout
   - Borders: 2px solid white confines around clickable elements for emphasis
   - Typography: Sans-serif font style in a bold weight for headlines and regular weight for body text, all in white. The font size is also responsive for mobile device compatibility.
   - Icons/Images: Use of metallic icons pairs well with the black and white theme, adding to the overall modern aesthetics.
